knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the customer buys a structure they can use safely and a clear view of what it needs. Your hourly rate, van and years of experience are not what the customer buys.
The lesson says extra work needs the customer's permission first, so the rot must be stopped, photographed and priced as a variation for written approval before work continues.

The lesson says a guarantee should be a fix-first window for minor defects in your own work, set in the offer, because that is a promise you can keep. Structural results you cannot measure, unlimited promises and conditional promises are not sound.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
